name: project_visual_media_gallery_video
title: Project Visual Media Gallery - Video
description: Video part of a project's visual media (old video_media / renderVideoMedia): title (block_title, default "Video Media Content") + grid of videos from src/content/vid/projects/<media.path>/ and its sub folders (project_media_gallery "videos" -> block_video, thumbnails from data_items_video.json, one list per folder, max 2 columns, id "video"). Renders nothing (no title) when there are no videos. Used by project_visual_media_gallery, can also be placed on its own.
